speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a history of easy bruising and are now presenting with persistent bleeding after a wisdom tooth extraction. To understand the severity and nature of your bleeding disorder, how long has the bleeding been continuing, and have you noticed similar issues with other minor cuts or nosebleeds?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency).

The family history of an uncle with joint swelling and bleeding, combined with your age and lack of specific factor replacement history, strongly suggests an X-linked recessive bleeding disorder. We need to confirm this immediately; can you confirm if the bleeding was spontaneous or only after trauma, and do you have any family history of factor VIII or IX deficiency?
